title.es: Castillo de nieve en isla flotante
title.pt: Castelo de neve em ilha flutuante

generated.description: A large castle built on a floating island, with stone walls and tall towers whose upper sections are covered in snow blocks and snow layers, set over grassy dirt and stone terrain edged with sand and gravel. It measures about 85 by 76 by 94 blocks and uses roughly 123,000 blocks, mostly stone, dirt and snow, with oak trim, brick accents, a few chests, furnaces, bookshelves, a record player and signs inside. No description was provided by the author.
